request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: Finds SQLDatabase in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py, then its direct subclasses via class_bases, excluding classes in tests/ folders. For each such class, lists methods defined in its own body (using symbol_profile's enclosing_class_symbol_id) whose names don't start with an underscore and that SQLDatabase does not itself define.
sql: WITH base AS (SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND s.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND s.kind = 'class'), direct_children AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN base b ON cb.base_symbol_id = b.symbol_id), base_methods AS (SELECT DISTINCT sp.name FROM code.symbol_profile sp JOIN base b ON sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = b.symbol_id WHERE sp.kind = 'method') SELECT DISTINCT c.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, sp.name AS method_name FROM direct_children dc JOIN code.symbols c ON c.symbol_id = dc.class_symbol_id JOIN code.symbol_profile sp ON sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = c.symbol_id AND sp.kind = 'method' WHERE c.file_id NOT LIKE 'tests/%' AND c.file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' AND sp.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND sp.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM base_methods) ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name
